command.join-description: /join -> Joins the voice channel and starts listening for voice commands
command.add-member-description: /addmember -> Adds a user with an alias so the bot recognizes them (admin required)
command.add-channel-description: /addchannel -> Adds a channel for the bot to recognize with an alias (admin required)
command.remove-user-description: /removeuser <user> or <alias>? -> Removes a user from the user list (admin required)
command.remove-channel-description: /removechannel <channel> -> Removes a channel from the channel list (admin required)

voice-commands-description.kick-description: 'hear me brown kick <alias>' -> kicks the user identified by the alias
voice-commands-description.alert-description: 'hear me brown alert' -> alerts deafened users in the channel until they undeafen
voice-commands-description.random-number-description: 'hear me brown random number' -> gives a random number
voice-commands-description.mute-description: 'hear me brown mute <alias>' -> server mutes the user identified by the alias
voice-commands-description.deaf-description: 'hear me brown deafen <alias>' -> server deafens the user identified by the alias
voice-commands-description.speak-description: 'hear me brown speak' -> undeafens and unmutes all users in the channel
voice-commands-description.move-description: 'hear me brown move <channel alias>' -> moves all users from the voice channel to the channel identified by the alias
voice-commands-description.who-connected-description: 'hear me brown who is connected' -> says aloud which users identified by alias are online
voice-commands-description.think-description: 'hear me brown think <prompt>' -> asks chatGPT a question and returns the answer by voice
voice-commands-description.music-description: 'hear me brown play <song>' -> searches for a song on YouTube and plays it
voice-commands-description.stop-all-speech-description: 'hear me brown stop' -> stops all current audio playback
voice-commands-description.delete-song-list-description: 'hear me brown clear queue' -> deletes the song queue
voice-commands-description.next-song-description: 'hear me brown next' -> skips to the next song in the queue
voice-commands-description.russian-roulette-description: 'hear me brown russian roulette' -> plays a game of Russian roulette
voice-commands-description.shoot-random-description: 'hear me brown shoot' -> makes a random shot
